releaseName: Who you are, your team and your job search
summary: The top bar now shows who is signed in and, on team plans, which team they act for, in a menu that also holds sign-out. A person on a one-person plan no longer sees the candidate record panel: their job search opens on its own, and download and delete sit under Your data in that menu. Team plans keep the picker in plain words: Working on, New job search, and Who can open this job search (#2861, #2860). The previous release extracted a job's requirements on the writing model's consent alone (#2857).
knownLimitations: Inviting people to a team still goes through the API or an operator; the account menu does not list the team's people yet. The operator reads feedback notes through the API only; there is no operator screen yet. Starting from a conversation needs the server's interviewer model. Signed-in users get the written interview only: live voice shows with the owner token (#2750). Agents cannot add text evidence yet (#2751). Credit packs sell only where the operator has set up Stripe; staging uses Stripe test mode. Self-service sign-up needs an invite code. The interview guide's paid walk is partial (#2623). The dating of relative source ages is not yet checked against a live search (#2579). Claude runs on the direct Claude API, outside the EU, until Claude on Vertex AI is available (#1564). French is beta until the French quality gate (milestone 83) runs.
